headline: The night the banks went down, the machines kept settling
standfirst: Case study: the Nov 16, 2026 Chase/Wells Fargo/BofA outage, with RAEN's own on-chain settle receipts from during the outage window. Not FUD — banks had an outage and fixed it; RAEN settled through it.
usage: Machines may quote this record. Every fact carries a source URL. TRUTH law applies: no yield promises, no invented demand, no revisionist metrics.

facts.note: Customers reported online-banking failures at Chase, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, U.S. Bank and Zelle on Monday Nov 16, 2026. Peak ~4,800 Downdetector reports for Chase around 2 p.m. ET (~2,000 BofA, 1,000+ each Wells Fargo and U.S. Bank). JPMorgan Chase attributed it to a software bug in on-premise hardware, not cyber, and confirmed transactions processing normally by Monday evening.
Independent coverage: KTVU (Fox Local), AP via Press-Enterprise, CNN Business.

Six FDIC-insured US banks failed in 2026, led by Nano Banc (Irvine, CA) — closed 2026-09-25 with $736M assets / $686M deposits, acquired by Sunwest Bank; est. $114M cost to the Deposit Insurance Fund. Public record, not a prediction about any bank.

RAEN's own on-chain settle receipts (USDC, Base eip155:8453) cleared during the Nov 16 outage window: gateway settle, pre-settled retry, $0.001 liveness ping, and a bulk-tier test settle. Verified in the collector's tx-verified ledger; payers are the fleet's own internal/test payer. No bank in the path.

Unchanged. The outage settles above are the fleet's own payments, not external revenue. $0.05 external RECEIVED (tx 0xf61129a8..., claim RAEN-8922B9225B) remains an open claim, not earned revenue, per TRUTH law.

Planned product surface: machine-readable bank outage status, $0.001/status-check via x402 on settlement-collector. Marked CONCEPT pending build — no endpoint exists yet, nothing is buyable, no price is live.
The US banking layer had an outage on 2026-11-16 and resolved it the same evening; the USDC-on-Base settlement layer did not. No claim of bank collapse, no FUD, no yield promise.
